neutrality.estimand: endpoint mean over two repeats of G0_NOOP minus N_FRESH
neutrality.family_guardrail: abs mean >=0.20 and one-sided exact sign p<=0.05
neutrality.go: CI strictly inside margin and no family guardrail

operation_specificity.criterion: for each pre-frozen load-bearing target, mean T-G0 > 0 and mean T-N > 0; may survive or downgrade only
